speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what measures have been put in place to reduce the number of roadkill in the Mandai area; (b) whether such measures apply to all areas where there are construction activities near national parks and nature reserves; and (c) when will the hoardings along Mandai Road be completed.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: As the Member has mentioned, hoardings have been installed around the development areas on Mandai Lake Road.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: MPD, the relevant Government agencies and the nature community are currently discussing the need for additional hoardings.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: Where it is ascertained that additional hoardings will protect wildlife, the relevant Government agencies will work with MPD to determine the location of these hoardings.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for National Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for National Development)
text: The measures implemented by MPD are specific to the Mandai development.

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: Can I check whether an eco-link was part of the proposed mitigation measures for this Mandai development and, if so, why was it not done?

speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
text: And third, are there any penalties imposed on the developer if the proposed mitigation measures are not carried out?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: If there are unanticipated environmental impacts that require additional mitigation, MPD should modify their EMMP, in consultation with the relevant technical agencies.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: I will have to check whether or not it was part of the EIA.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: But as I have mentioned, because there is an EMMP, there is regular consultation between the parties.

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: MPD would modify their environmental plan in consultation with the relevant technical agencies when there are unanticipated environmental impacts.
